newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore plans S$1.7 bln on roads over 5 years.
newsitem.headline: Singapore plans S$1.7 bln on roads over 5 years.

text.p: Singapore plans to spend about Singapore $1.7 billion (US$1.2 billion) on building roads over the next five years, Communications Minister Mah Bow Tan said on Tuesday.

"In the next five years, the government will spend some S$1.7 billion on road building alone, an increase of 55 percent from the past five years's S$1.1 billion," Tan said at the opening of a new expressway.
"The money will go to building more expressways, flyovers and roads to improve traffic flow and serve new areas of development, he said.
